name: real_ind13_pv2021_jpl
description: All-real-shape scenario: FEC = German industrial plant LG13 (night ~2 % of peak, Sat ~30 %, Sun ~3 % of weekday: closest to practice) from Zenodo 3899018 (2016, 15-min), DST rows removed, wall-clock time, weekday-aligned to 2025, affinely rescaled (weekday-night median -> 35 kW, annual max -> 990 kW); FNE = PVGIS-SARAH3 2021 (organiser method); EV = JPL sessions ['1-1-179-800', '1-1-179-799', '1-1-179-810', '1-1-179-815'] rescaled to 9.33 MWh.
